correctness.rationale: PASS: With chi_w=(-1)^{deg_G(w)}, O=(n-sum chi_w)/2. Conditioning on the presence of a noninduced copy of H forces d_H(u) incident edges at each copied u, hence E[chi_w|copy]=(-1)^d s^(n-1-d), s=1-2p; outside copy the expectation remains s^(n-1). Linearity over M_H=(n)_v/Aut(H) gives equation (1), with no independence assumption between motif copies. For pure even/odd degrees, each bracket factors s^(n-1-d)(1∓s^d); the parenthetic term is strictly positive for -1<s<1 and all exponents share parity. Factoring s^(n-1-Delta) yields midpoint zero multiplicity exactly n-1-Delta and nonzero leading coefficient from m maximum-degree vertices. At q=0 midpoint covariance is nonzero. Independent enumeration of all graph edge subsets for n=3,4 and rational p=1/4,1/2,3/4 matches exact covariance for K2,P3,K3, including a mixed-degree motif. Thus unrestricted statement is backed by character derivation, not finite graph tests.
